claude_proposed_widenings.name: activated_nonspell_ongoing_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's Bonus Action arms the weapon for up to 1 minute, then a later hit with that specific weapon opens a save-gated rider and ends the armed state. Existing magic-item families only support immediate activations, reactions, passives, summons, or composites of those; none support an activated lingering on-hit rider.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature.
